commands.final_collector:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import sqlite3
import time

sys.path.insert(0, 'tests/live-e2e/local-topology')
import cp_listener

def checked(argv):
    return subprocess.check_output(argv, text=True).strip()

container = 't204-baseline-stargate-control-1'
item = json.loads(checked(['docker', 'inspect', container]))[0]
pid = item['State']['Pid']
result = {name: item[name] for name in ('Id', 'Image', 'State', 'Mounts')}
result['launch'] = {name: item['Config'][name] for name in ('Entrypoint', 'Cmd', 'User', 'Env')}
result['boundary'] = {name: item['HostConfig'][name] for name in
                      ('NetworkMode', 'CapDrop', 'SecurityOpt', 'LogConfig', 'PortBindings', 'ReadonlyRootfs')}
result['kernel'] = checked(['uname', '-r'])
result['architecture'] = checked(['uname', '-m'])
result['docker'] = checked(['docker', 'version', '--format', '{{.Server.Version}}'])
result['listeners'] = cp_listener.snapshot(pid)
cp_listener.assert_boundary(result['listeners'])
result['health'] = checked(['nsenter', '-t', str(pid), '-n', 'curl', '-sS', '--max-time', '5',
                            '-w', '%{http_code}:%{size_download}', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz'])
assert result['health'] == '200:0'
result['namespace_ipv6'] = checked(['nsenter', '-t', str(pid), '-n', 'sysctl',
                                  'net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6', 'net.ipv6.bindv6only'])
result['package_manifest'] = checked(['docker', 'exec', container, 'sh', '-c',
                                    'find /opt/stargate -type f -exec sha256sum {} +'])
config = next(m['Source'] for m in item['Mounts'] if m['Destination'] == '/etc/stargate')
result['configuration_sha256'] = {
    'tokens.yaml': hashlib.sha256((Path(config) / 'tokens.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'installer_local_env': hashlib.sha256(Path('target/t204/local.env').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
result['harness_sha256'] = {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
    ('tests/live-e2e/local-topology/cp_listener.py', 'tests/live-e2e/local-topology/observer.py',
     'tests/live-e2e/local-topology/observer_probe.go', 'tests/live-e2e/local-topology/run.py')}
if '--acknowledged' in sys.argv:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 180
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        reply = subprocess.run(['docker', 'exec', container, 'cat', '/tmp/stargate-control/auth-delivery'],
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        delivery = reply.stdout.strip()
        if reply.returncode == 0 and delivery.startswith('ACKNOWLEDGED('):
            break
        time.sleep(1)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('exact token acknowledgement did not become available')
    state = next(m['Source'] for m in item['Mounts'] if m['Destination'] == '/var/lib/stargate')
    with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{state}/control.db?mode=ro', uri=True) as db:
        generation = db.execute('SELECT generation FROM token_generation').fetchone()[0]
    assert delivery == f'ACKNOWLEDGED({generation})', (delivery, generation)
    assert generation > 0
    result['token_delivery'] = {'state': delivery, 'persisted_generation': generation,
                                'exact_acknowledgement': True}
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
